findings.claim: The change deletes the `case <= byte.MaxValue` Str8 branch in the string header writer. This is unrelated to the analyzer / SuppressSourceGeneration bug. Whether Str8 is intentionally dropped is not recorded in the ledger. Nothing in the requirement calls for this change.
